evidence: From Rangitoto Wharf, Rangitoto Summit Track takes you up the dormant volcano of Rangitoto to Summit Lookout.
From here, it’s 2 min to Rangitoto Summit Lookout – a great picnic spot.
You can complete the Crater Rim Track before returning to Rangitoto Wharf the same way you came.

ways.label: Alternative route to Summit Lookout via Wilson’s Park Track

via.name: Rangitoto Summit Track
via.quote: Wilson’s Park Track is signposted from Summit Track on your left (going up).

evidence: Wilson’s Park Track is signposted from Summit Track on your left (going up). The turnoff is 40 min from Rangitoto Wharf.
The track is an alternative, longer route to Summit Lookout and has good shade for hot days.

doubts: Rangitoto Wharf has no feature or name entry, so the start ref is null. The end, Summit Lookout on the summit/tihi of Rangitoto, is given the peak Rangitoto (T6). W2 (Wilson's Park Track) is described only as 'an alternative, longer route to Summit Lookout' branching 40 min from the wharf; the page does not say whether it is walked up, down or both, so its shape is null, and its own '1 hr / 1.4 km (one way)' covers only that track, not the whole way.
